Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
What happens if a vampire with a Humanitas or an old-school Assamite gets an
Undying Thirst and a vampire is in torpor? Is the vampire stuck because he
has to diablerize but cannot?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Johannes Walch" <johanne...@vekn.de> wrote in message news:d1udr5$opu$1...@stu1id2.ip.tesion.net...

> What happens if a vampire with a Humanitas or an old-school Assamite gets an
> Undying Thirst and a vampire is in torpor? Is the vampire stuck because he
> has to diablerize but cannot?

No. Undying Thirst has no effect unless you can diablerize.
"When there are any vampires in torpor that this vampire can diablerize, ..."
